organization.name: Music Travel Consultants (MTC)
organization.fit: MTC markets music travel and lists a planned March 3 NYIMF event. The NYIMF/Troen match is unconfirmed. This is an illustrative research candidate.
organization.next_action: Research example only. Troen relationship and interest are unknown. No recommendation to contact MTC.

evidence.label: Organization identity
evidence.text: MTC describes itself as an Indianapolis-based tour operator creating customized trips for student music groups.

evidence.label: Public service description

evidence.label: Planned event listing
evidence.text: Its 2027 calendar lists the New York Invitational Music Festival at Carnegie Hall on March 3 for high school bands, choirs and orchestras. No reviewed page names Troen as producer.

unknowns: Whether the NYIMF listing refers to Troen's March 3 event
